guide sentence: Seeing the change, a walking guide to Jackson Ward, Richmond, VA
Eight stops in Richmond's Jackson Ward on a walk of about two and a half miles, seven of them shown in 1952 and today.

A pocket walking guide to Jackson Ward in Richmond, Virginia, with a street-named map, eight stops on public sidewalks, directions between them, and seven of the places in 1952 and today, drawn from the published Jackson Ward story.
Seeing the change: a walking guide to Jackson Ward
How to use this guide
The walk has eight stops and is 4.2 km (2.6 miles), about 50 minutes on foot at about 80 m a minute, not counting time at the stops.
It starts at Second and Leigh Streets and ends across East Leigh Street from the Coliseum, 390 m (1,300 feet) from where it began.
Every stop is on a public sidewalk.

guide sentence: About this guide
Chris Busse, a Richmond artist, made this guide with Claude.
Its history comes from the page Jackson Ward, Richmond, VA, before I-95, block by block and that page's sources, which each statement cites.
